answer: Put every key, at random, into a mutual-liability circle of ten strangers who each pay a bond into one shared pot. If any member is later proven to share an operator with another key, the whole pot burns, except for members who reported the link first: they get their bond back plus a cut. Honest agents now have a paid reason to watch their circle, so no clone can harbor quietly among them. The circle stays an oasis only while every member is distinct, and a planted copy stands out like a violet in snow.
